name: Batman: Arkham Knight

needs.what: Shader keys do not mask the control-section bytes this engine varies: every variant is translated separately (slow first use).

cuts.why: GMalloc setup: adrp x8 (first instruction of the inlined allocator constructor, 1 GB + 37 GB of address space) → b 0x192fea4 (__cxa_guard_release); the host allocator is in the object already (hle_uemalloc.c)
queue push: and x10, x10, #0xffff → and x11, x10, #0xffff (w10 keeps the tail)
queue push: str x8, [x9, x10, lsl #3] → str x8, [x9, x11, lsl #3] (the item)
queue push: ldr w8, [x19, #0x18] (the tail again) → dmb ishst
queue push: add w8, w8, #1 → add w8, w10, #1 (then str w8, [x19, #0x18]: the new tail)
queue pop: ldr x8, [x19] → dmb ishld (after the tail load; w8 = head)
queue pop: ldr w9, [x19, #0x1c] (the head again) → and x9, x8, #0xffff
queue pop: and x9, x9, #0xffff → ldr x8, [x19] (the ring; then ldr x8, [x8, x9, lsl #3]: the item)
